description: Source code for the QualManager class in the Android media stagefright RTSP module, managing bitrate adaptation and timeout watchers.

classes.name: QualManager::Watcher
classes.description: A thread-based watcher class that triggers a switch after a timeout.

classes.name: QualManager
classes.description: Manages bitrate adaptation logic and watcher instances for RTSP streaming.

methods.name: QualManager::Watcher::Watcher
methods.description: Constructor initializing the watcher with a time limit.

methods.name: QualManager::Watcher::isExpired
methods.description: Checks if the watcher has expired (triggered).

methods.name: QualManager::Watcher::setup
methods.description: Sets up the watcher to start timing.

methods.name: QualManager::Watcher::exit
methods.description: Signals the watcher thread to exit.

methods.name: QualManager::Watcher::threadLoop
methods.description: Main loop of the watcher thread, waiting for timeout or exit.

methods.name: QualManager::QualManager
methods.description: Constructor initializing bitrate parameters and watcher instances.

methods.name: QualManager::getTargetBitrate
methods.description: Returns the current target bitrate if updated.

methods.name: QualManager::isNeedToDowngrade
methods.description: Checks if a low bitrate condition has expired.

methods.name: QualManager::setTargetBitrate
methods.description: Adjusts target bitrate based on packet loss and watcher states.

methods.name: QualManager::setMinMaxBitrate
methods.description: Sets minimum and maximum bitrate bounds.

methods.name: QualManager::setBitrateData
methods.description: Updates watcher states based on current bitrate.

methods.name: QualManager::clampingBitrate
methods.description: Clamps a bitrate value within min and max bounds.
